metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1941 · Sergeant York
metas.description: A Tennessee farmer and marksman is drafted in World War I, and struggles with his pacifist inclinations before becoming one of the most celebrated war heroes.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1958 · A Night to Remember
metas.description: On her maiden voyage in April 1912, the supposedly unsinkable RMS Titanic strikes an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1916 · Intolerance
metas.description: Four historical tales depict the ongoing human struggle against prejudice and inhumanity.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1935 · Captain Blood
metas.description: After treating a Monmouth rebel against King James II in 1680s England, a young Irish doctor is exiled as a slave to Jamaica where he captures a Spanish galleon and becomes the most feared pirate of the Caribbean.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1964 · Becket
metas.description: King Henry II of England comes to terms with his affection for his close friend and confidant Thomas Becket, who finds his true honor by observing God's divine will rather than the King's.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1969 · The Color of Pomegranates
metas.description: The life of the Armenian poet Sayat-Nova, from childhood to death: his spiritual journey, artistic endeavors, and inner conflicts within the cultural and historical context of Armenia. Hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1964 · The Gospel According to St. Matthew
metas.description: The life of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Matthew. Film shows Christ as a Marxist avant-la-lettre and therefore uses half of the text of Matthew.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1943 · Day of Wrath
metas.description: The young wife of an aging priest falls in love with his son amidst the horror of a merciless witch hunt in 17th-century Denmark.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1944 · Ivan the Terrible, Part I
metas.description: During the early part of his reign, Ivan the Terrible faces betrayal from the aristocracy and even his closest friends as he seeks to unite the Russian people.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1959 · The Human Condition I: No Greater Love
metas.description: A Japanese pacifist, unable to face the dire consequences of conscientious objection, is transformed by his attempts to compromise with the demands of war-time Japan.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1965 · Chimes at Midnight

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1927 · Napoleon
metas.description: A film about the French general's youth and early military career.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1959 · The Bridge
metas.description: In 1945, Germany is being overrun, and nobody is left to fight but teenagers.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1933 · Queen Christina
metas.description: Queen Christina of Sweden is a popular monarch who is loyal to her country. However, when she falls in love with a Spanish envoy, she must choose between the throne and the man she loves.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1959 · The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
metas.description: As a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist struggles to maintain his determination to keep his ideals.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 1961 · The Human Condition III: A Soldier's Prayer
metas.description: His ideals challenged by life as a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist faces ever greater tests in his fight for survival.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1946 · Ivan the Terrible, Part II: The Boyars' Plot
metas.description: As Ivan the Terrible attempts to consolidate his power by establishing a personal army, his political rivals, the Russian boyars, plot to assassinate their Tsar.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1934 · The Scarlet Empress
metas.description: A German noblewoman enters into a loveless marriage with the dim-witted, unstable heir to the Russian throne, then plots to oust him from power.
